title: Process 3D Technology And App
description: Create a new technology `process` with part `3d` for simulating processing of components through subtractive and additive measures (cutting, drilling, attachments), built on the repo's brep kernel (kernel_3d_brepkit). Add a vcs-backed document crate process/3d/rs, a plugin app process/plugin/rs (app id process3d-play, World3d viewport), example fixtures, AGENTS.md seeds, and register the new technology across Cargo.toml, package.json, repo/lib/js/index.ts, framework/core/js/index.ts, .claude/launch.json, and s/manifest/resources.manifest.json.
summary:
Created the new `process` technology and its `3d` app for simulating component processing (subtractive cuts/drills and additive attachments) through the repo's brep kernel (kernel_3d_brepkit). Added a vcs-backed document crate `process/3d/rs` (Process3dDocument model with Stock/ProcessStep/ProcessMeasure, using vcs's CollectionOp/Identified/Patchable pattern for undoable step-list edits, 5 unit tests). Added the plugin app `process/plugin/rs` (app id process3d-play) with a World3d "Workpiece" viewport driven by a memoized BrepkitKernel replay session (cut_sync/fuse_sync per step), document/catalogue/inspector panels, undo/redo, cursor scrubbing through the process timeline, EN/DE terminology, and 11 unit tests. Added two example fixtures (timber beam with miter cuts + dowel joinery, drilled plate) and AGENTS.md seeds. Registered the technology across the workspace: Cargo.toml, package.json, repo/lib/js/index.ts, framework/core/js/index.ts, .claude/launch.json (process3d-react-dev, port 6022), and s/manifest/resources.manifest.json. Verified: cargo check/test pass for both crates (16/16 tests), wasm build succeeds, plugin registry auto-discovery, and manual browser end-to-end drive (viewport renders the kernel-tessellated beam, panels work, inspector edits round-trip through the kernel).

Follow-up: added VS Code dev launch configs for parity with sibling technologies — .vscode/launch.json gained "🛠️dev🪚process🏙️3d⚛️react" (port 6022), "🛠️dev🪚process🏙️3d🧊wgpu🌐wasm" (port 6122), and "🛠️dev🪚process🏙️3d🧊wgpu🖥️native", mirroring procedural3d's exact naming/emoji/port/order convention (order 195/195.1/195.2). Audited the rest of the repo (README, CI workflows, other IDE config dirs, compounds section, test files) and confirmed no other procedural3d-style touchpoint needed a process3d analog.

Note: mid-task an accidental `git stash`/`git stash pop` popped an unrelated pre-existing stash and caused merge conflicts across ~15 unrelated files; this was fully recovered (files restored to clean HEAD, stash left intact for its owner, no work lost). Separately, a path-less `ticket_close` call during this follow-up accidentally closed an unrelated ticket (WINDOW-TOOL-PANEL-WITH-RECURSIVE-CATEGORY-GROUPS); that was caught and reopened immediately.
